Good morning,

I am writing to express interest in hiring your Wexcombe for a commercial shoot that we are undertaking. We require the vehicle for 31st August 2027, with the shoot scheduled to take place from 10:30 am until 8pm. We will collect the vehicle from your garage. I have attached a copy of my driving licence for your reference.

Best regards,
Zane Fennimore +70 657 720 4308
